scheme_name: Top Class Education For Students With Disabilities
other_conditions: Student must be admitted in a full-time course in a notified institution
Disability percentage must be 40% or above
Applicant must be pursuing a graduate, postgraduate degree or diploma
Applicant must not be the third sibling in the family availing the scholarship
benefits_summary: Provides full tuition fee up to Rs 2 LPA, monthly living allowance of Rs 3,000, annual books stipend, one-time assistance for laptop/computer and assistive devices up to Rs 30,000 each, and a special allowance of Rs 2,000 per month.
